metadata.title: That 2 kill surprise where Valorant was like ‘Wait, you’re serious? Okay then!’
metadata.description:
Wait, I didn’t even try and got 2 kills?
Enemy must’ve been playing invisible mode.
Click if your best kills come from pure chaos and luck.
Valorant’s logic is officially broken again.

Tap if your kills don’t make any sense either!
